segments.text: A man wakes up in the ocean. At night. No ship. No idea how he got there.
No chance. Nobody falls off a cruise ship and just wakes up. Let's go look.
November {2022|twenty twenty two}. The Carnival Valor, bound for Mexico. James Grimes, {28|twenty eight}, wins the air guitar contest.
Around eleven, he heads for the restroom. He never comes back. And he remembers none of it.
He comes to in the Gulf of Mexico. No life jacket. So he treads water. All night.
Something with a fin bumps his leg. He chews a floating stick, just to taste something that isn't salt.
Next evening, lights. A ship. He swims for it, waving his socks. Socks. Nobody spots socks.
The crew spots him. A Coast Guard helicopter lowers a swimmer, who says James had maybe a minute left.
Up to {20|twenty} hours, treading water. I was wrong. Case closed.
